answer: Locks are recorded in willow, expire in trellis, and atlas lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 95 aliases therefore needs 137 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4167 identities would post 1348 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
